questions.stem: A 45-year old woman is admitted for elective left-sided lobectomy of upper lobe for lung nodule with suspicion of malignancy. She was diagnosed with a 1.2 cm pulmonary nodule 3 months ago. On repeat CT chest, the size of the nodule increased to 3 cm. During anesthesia, what is the best device for intraoperative ventilation of this patient?

options.label: B
options.text: Regular endotracheal tube and a bronchial blocker
